summary: Hyperscale Data, Inc. filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for an at-the-market (ATM) offering of up to $300 million of its Class A common stock (ticker: GPUS) through sales agent Spartan Capital Securities. Sales will be made under Rule 415 on the NYSE American at prevailing market prices, with Spartan receiving a 3% commission. This is a routine shelf takedown to raise capital, not a special situation. There are no activist, M&A, restructuring, or other extraordinary corporate events. The filing provides standard risk factors and use of proceeds for general corporate purposes. What to watch: dilution risk given the low $0.3979 share price and potential impact on existing shareholders.
